references.title: On the Localization of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles with Cellular Networks
references.authors: Irshad A. Meer, Mustafa Ozger, Cicek Cavdar
references.location: Section II, equations(1)-(5), page3 of PDF; BS25m in Section IV-A
references.supports: UMa-AV LOS probability p1/d1, LOS and NLOS pathloss for ground-BS/aerial-UE geometry. Paper simulations use BS25m, 2GHz, 10MHz,46dBm, NF9dB.
references.adaptation: Here fc5GHz,90MHz occupied,NF7dB; no random LOS/shadowing. We compute p*PL_LOS+(1-p)*max(PL_LOS,PL_NLOS) in dB as a deterministic mean-loss abstraction. Validated implementation scope22.5<h<=100m,BS25m. Not a full3GPP implementation or site measurement.
